description: This file declares functions related to loading and integrating Lua-based configuration in the lighttpd web server. It includes function prototypes for loading Lua configurations and pushing Lua tables to the Lua state machine.

methods.name: li_config_lua_load
methods.description: Loads a Lua configuration file and applies configuration actions; handles setup checks and arguments.

methods.name: li_lua_push_action_table
methods.description: Pushes the server and worker context as a Lua table for configuration or scripting purposes.

methods.name: li_lua_push_setup_table
methods.description: Pushes a setup table into the Lua state for configuration purposes.
